events.factual_description: The Anthem presents Social Distortion with Descendents and The Chats in Washington, DC on Friday, September 4, 2026. Doors are at 6:00 PM and the show starts at 7:30 PM. The authorized Ticketmaster page independently confirms the September 4 date, 7:30 PM time and The Anthem. The Anthem places Social Distortion in the Born To Kill cycle, the band's first new-album cycle in fifteen years, following Mike Ness's serious illness; it also identifies Descendents with the Southern California pop-punk lineage they helped define and The Chats with Australian pub/garage-punk roots. The exact same three-band package is officially listed at the Stone Pony Summer Stage in Asbury Park on September 5 as part of the Born To Kill World Tour, confirming that the Washington show is a strong tour stop rather than a one-off. No ticket price is recorded because the accessible authorized ticket page does not expose a stable verified price.

en.why_it_matters: This is a lineage bill rather than three unrelated punk bookings. Social Distortion brings nearly five decades of Southern California punk and roots-rock into its first new-album cycle in fifteen years; Descendents bring the melodic SoCal branch they helped define; and The Chats push the same stripped-down urgency through contemporary Australian pub punk. In one local night, the genre's continuity is audible rather than commemorative.
en.trip_verdict: If you're in the DMV, make The Wharf the evening and go; no regional travel calculation is needed. If Washington does not fit, the same three-band package reaches Asbury Park the next night, so there is useful flexibility without treating this stop as a one-off.

es.why_it_matters: No es un cartel de tres nombres puestos juntos. Social Distortion trae casi cinco décadas de punk y roots rock del sur de California dentro de su primer ciclo de disco nuevo en quince años; Descendents, la rama melódica de esa escena que ayudaron a definir; y The Chats empujan esa misma urgencia desde el pub punk australiano contemporáneo. En una sola noche local, la continuidad del género se escucha en vivo y no como pieza de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Si estás en el DMV, haría del Wharf la noche y listo; no hace falta justificar un viaje regional. Si Washington no embona, el mismo cartel toca en Asbury Park al día siguiente, así que hay flexibilidad real sin tratar esta parada como un one-off.
